Store, check and delete browser sessions

Usage:
  kaab sessions [command]

Available Commands:
  create      Store a Playwright storage state as a session
  delete      Delete a session
  list        List sessions
  verify      Run a session's validity probe (costs verify credits)

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for sessions

Global Flags:
      --base-url string   API base URL (KAAB_BASE_URL; https://api.kaab.ist/v1 by default)
      --json              print the API's JSON instead of a table
      --profile string    profile to use (KAAB_PROFILE; the current profile by default)
      --test              use the profile's test-mode key (sk_test_)

Use "kaab sessions [command] --help" for more information about a command.
